# Drag start throws when the pressed node is replaced during the start delay

## Context

This came out of #19288's red arm, `WorkstationDragAffordancesNL` › "the ordinary body-mounted tab proxy has a theme-owned surface in both modes", which fails under the 1920×1080 headless screen. The second (light) pass presses the Audit tab header and moves 17 px. On failing runs:
- the main-thread Mouse sensor holds `currentElement: neo-tab-header-button-17, dragging: true`;
- `Neo.main.addon.DragDrop` holds `dragZoneId: null, dragElementRootId: null`;
- the App's tab SortZone never logs an `onDragStart`, and no proxy appears;
- the page throws `event.target.getBoundingClientRect is not a function at DragDrop.onDragStart (DragDrop.mjs:654)`. The stack runs `Mouse.startDrag` ← `onDistanceChange` ← the start-delay timeout (`Mouse.mjs:179`).

The same arm passes when a settle separates the preceding theme switch from the press. Measured on the #19288 branch, 2026-09-26, with App-worker logs read back through Neural Link.

## The Problem

`sensor/Base#trigger` dispatches a sensor event on `document` when the pressed node is no longer connected. Its JSDoc explains why: a gesture's own side effects can remove or replace the source node, and a detached node swallows the event. It also states the contract: *consumers read `event.detail`, never the dispatch target*. That fallback came with `#15282`.

`DragDrop#onDragStart` still reads the dispatch target:
- `event.target.getBoundingClientRect()`: `document` has no such method, so the handler throws before it resolves the zone or sends `drag:start`;
- `event.path || event.composedPath()`: from a `document` dispatch that is `[document, window]`, so even without the throw, the zone could not be resolved from the path.

`getEventData` builds the App payload's `path` the same way. Every other drag event reaches the App by `dragZoneId` (`manager/DomEvent#fire`). `drag:start` is the one routed through component listeners, by path.

So when the pressed node is replaced between mousedown and the start threshold, the gesture dies silently. The sensor believes it is dragging, while no zone and no App session exist. A tab header re-rendered by a theme switch or an Overflow projection inside the 100 ms start delay is enough.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/main/draggable/sensor/Mouse.mjs#startDrag` already puts the press's own path (`path: startEvent.path`, captured at mousedown) and the pressed `element` into `detail`.
- `src/main/addon/DragDrop.mjs#onDragStart` resolves `dragZoneId` from the path against `zoneRegistrations`, which are keyed by drag element root id. It records `dragProxyRect` / `offsetX` / `offsetY` from the pressed node's rect. `getEventData` serializes the path for the App.
- A replaced node keeps its id: the vdom re-renders the same component. The press's path therefore still names the right ids, and the replacement node with that id has the live geometry.

## The Fix

`DragDrop` reads the sensor's `detail`, as `Base#trigger` documents:
1. `onDragStart` and `getEventData` take the path from `detail.path`, falling back to the dispatch path only when `detail` carries none.
2. `onDragStart` measures the pressed element from `detail.element`, or from the connected node with its id when it was replaced, instead of from `event.target`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: a unit arm dispatches `drag:start` from `document` with a pressed element that was replaced by a same-id node. `onDragStart` does not throw, resolves the owning `dragZoneId` from the press's path, measures the replacement node, and sends `drag:start` whose `path` names the pressed element's ids.
- [ ] AC-2: the connected-node case keeps today's zone, rect and path (existing arms green).
- [ ] AC-3: under #19288's 1920×1080 flag, the tab-proxy arm's light pass no longer loses its drag start: no `getBoundingClientRect` page error, and the tab SortZone opens a session.

*AC-3 amended 2026-09-26 by the author, after measuring the fix.* The original AC-3 asked the whole arm to pass. With the fix, the start is delivered on every run. The arm then meets a second layer: the press re-renders the header, and on some runs no connected successor exists at the start, so the proxy is sized from an empty rect (2 px against 48). That layer is not this defect: it is #19285's focused-tab churn (the Overflow projection withholding the focused tab), fixed by #19294 (merged as a50ae57ce8). With #19294's Overflow diff applied on top of this fix, the arm went 8/8 isolated and 2/2 whole-file (2026-09-26). *Corrected 2026-09-27: this line first named #19288, which carries only the screen flag.*

## Out of Scope

- Why the header node is replaced right after a theme switch. A re-render there is legitimate; the drag must survive it.
- Pointer Events migration (#17889).
